# teams_work_location_detection_policy (Resource)

Manages the WorkLocationDetectionPolicy policy via New-CsTeamsWorkLocationDetectionPolicy / Get-CsTeamsWorkLocationDetectionPolicy / Set-CsTeamsWorkLocationDetectionPolicy / Remove-CsTeamsWorkLocationDetectionPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `enable_work_location_detection` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableWorkLocationDetection parameter.
- `user_settings_default` (String) Maps to the -UserSettingsDefault parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
